name: Payments or activity in jurisdictions unrelated to the customer's business or goods
description: Payments, counterparties or sales originate in or go to countries with no link to the customer, declared business, services or goods.
fp: Customers with growing international business or diaspora links may produce this pattern legitimately.

links.name: Payment to account in third country unrelated to services
links.ctx: Intermediary asks for payment to a bank account in a jurisdiction where neither the service nor the intermediary operates.

links.name: Mismatch between customer location and activity geography
links.ctx: Transactions concentrate in countries with no link to the customer's residence, business or stated purpose.

links.name: Traffic spikes outside merchant geography
links.ctx: Sales volume arises from countries unrelated to the merchant's market.

links.name: Payments to or from unrelated high-risk jurisdictions
links.ctx: Payments involve countries with no link to declared business.

links.name: Payments to or from jurisdictions unrelated to goods
links.ctx: Counterparties are in different countries from the goods' origin or destination, often via third-country accounts.

links.name: Payments to or from higher-risk jurisdictions without clear relationship
links.ctx: Transfers to recipients in conflict-affected areas with no documented relationship or stated purpose.
